en.hubeali: From him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from one of our companions, from Zurara who said,
‘I asked Abu Ja’farasws about a Qiblah of the one confused. So heasws said: ‘He can pray Salāt wherever he so desires to (in any direction)’.
en.sarwar: 10. It is a narration from him (narrator of previous Hadith) by Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from ibn abu ‘Umayr from certain persons of our people from Zurarah who has said the following:

“I once asked abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about al-Qiblah (al-Ka‘bah) for one who is confused. He (the Imam) said, ‘He performs as he wishes.’ It is also narrated that he performs Salah (prayer) facing four directions.”
